blockers.description: Plan 84-02 Task 1 is a blocking checkpoint:decision. It asks the operator to confirm four one-way concretizations before any code is written: (1) the CalendarSubscriptions table shape incl. RevokedAt tombstone, (2) the 32-byte Base64Url token stored in plain text, (3) the questboard-event-{eventId} entry identifier scheme, (4) the /feeds/calendar/{feedToken}.ics route on its own AllowAnonymous controller. No decision was recorded before the pause.
blockers.workaround: None — the gate is by design. Execution of 84-02 cannot start without it.

blockers.description: Open sub-question raised by the operator against item 1: should revoked subscription rows be purged on a retention schedule (suggested 30 days) via a Hangfire recurring job, rather than kept as tombstones forever? Advice was given but no decision was made.
blockers.workaround: Does not block 84-02. RevokedAt is exactly the column a retention job needs, so the sweep can be added later at identical cost — it is NOT a one-way door. Recommended path: approve the four as specified, capture retention as a separate follow-up slice.
